queries.request: September lo ae weekday lo on-time deliveries worst ga unnayi?
queries.sql: WITH stops AS (SELECT t.shipment_id, t.stop_seq, MIN(date(t.arrived_at)) AS arr_date, MIN(t.arrived_at) AS arrived_at, s.delivery_date AS del_date, MAX(o.window_end) AS window_end, strftime('%w', s.delivery_date) AS wd FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id=t.shipment_id LEFT JOIN shipment_items si ON si.shipment_id=t.shipment_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=si.order_id AND o.site_id=t.site_id WHERE s.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' AND t.arrived_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.shipment_id, t.stop_seq) SELECT CASE wd WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' END AS weekday, wd, COUNT(*) AS stops, SUM(CASE WHEN date(arrived_at) < del_date OR (date(arrived_at)=del_date AND substr(arrived_at,12,5) <= window_end) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ontime, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN date(arrived_at) < del_date OR (date(arrived_at)=del_date AND substr(arrived_at,12,5) <= window_end) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS ontime_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN date(arrived_at) < del_date OR (date(arrived_at)=del_date AND substr(arrived_at,12,5) <= window_end) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS late FROM stops GROUP BY wd ORDER BY ontime_pct

queries.sql: WITH stops_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.shipment_id, t.stop_seq, t.site_id, t.arrived_at, o.order_id, o.window_end, s.delivery_date FROM trip_outcomes t JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id=t.shipment_id JOIN shipment_items si ON si.shipment_id=t.shipment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=si.order_id AND o.site_id=t.site_id WHERE s.delivery_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31') SELECT CASE strftime('%w', delivery_date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' END as weekday, strftime('%w', delivery_date) as wnum, COUNT(*) as order_deliveries, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(arrived_at,12,5) <= window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ontime, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN substr(arrived_at,12,5) <= window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) as ontime_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(arrived_at,12,5) > window_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as late_n FROM stops_orders GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY ontime_pct ASC
